title: Rainbow Lamp
description:
The Rainbow Lamp is a Redstone Lamp that is always on (light level 15) but changes color depending on the signal strength it receives.

Signal strength 0 to 15 gives, in order: white, orange, magenta, light blue, yellow, lime, pink, gray, light gray, cyan, purple, blue, brown, green, red, black.

properties.label: Redstone
properties.value: Color follows the incoming signal strength, 0 to 15
